data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure as the true workflow (Restaurants, then location search and suggestion, then filter and apply) with the right location and filter parameters, but it adds an unneeded optional save-to-trip step and a spurious trip_name parameter, and its filter step is a little vague.
